versions.changelog:
**Changelog for github-collab v0.1.5:**

- Major refactor: restructured project files, expanded module coverage, and added extensive documentation.
- Added OpenClaw native integration modules and enhanced controller logic.
- Introduced CLI tools for detailed management of tasks, agents, projects, and configuration.
- Implemented advanced database, configuration, performance, and session management utilities.
- Expanded test coverage and improved project performance (notably with 100x cache/database optimization).
- Significantly enriched documentation (CONFIG.md, PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md, DEPENDENCIES.md, etc.) and removed outdated/incomplete files.

**Major update with architectural overhaul and enhanced modularity.**

- Complete project reorganization: 179 files added, 77 removed, 5 changed for a more modular, scalable structure.
- Database schema and management have been redesigned for improved performance, extendability, and monitoring.
- Configuration system now supports robust prioritization (env > config file > default) and covers more parameters.
- Architecture documentation and module roles rewritten for clarity; expanded to include all new modules and scripts.
- Old workflow, meta, and summary docs removed; new, detailed guides and coverage reports included.
- Enhanced agent management: multiple agent types, recovery mechanisms, and better parallelism controls.

Version 0.1.3 of github-collab has no file changes.

- No updates or modifications in this release.
- Existing features and documentation remain unchanged.

- Major refactor: revamped agent management, task queue, and configuration modules; expanded documentation.
- Added new modules for agent binding, deployment, document, and review agents.
- Introduced extensive database utilities for agent, config, and session management.
- Enhanced example scripts and added CLI utilities for configuration and agent update.
- Improved test coverage: added integration and performance tests.
- Cleaned up deprecated guides and documentation files.

- Introduced extensive documentation and test coverage with new files for installation, project summary, push instructions, status, test reports, and guides.
- Added agent registration management via the new core/agent-registry.js.
- Improved task management and coordination logic in main controller and task manager.
- Expanded test suite with additional scripts and structured testing guides.
- Updated core workflow for better multi-agent task assignment and progress tracking.

Initial release of GitHub Collaboration Skill.

- Supports multi-agent collaboration (Main, Dev, and Test Agents) with independent task queues.
- Integrates with GitHub using the `gh` CLI for automated project and repo creation.
- Task management via SQLite: tracks statuses, assignments, and agent activity.
- Provides real-time progress reports in Markdown format.
- Includes database schema and configuration options for integration and notifications.
- Offers sample code and detailed usage instructions.
